U_0x0074F6: Mobile weapon guarding Baral's Garden; a downsized, mass-made Keren.
U_0x0075C3: An artificial god that came to Earth long ago - in truth the control core of 'Baral,' a planetary defense system of unknown make. Linking with psychics called Miko or Mashiach, it wraps its planet in a barrier trapping those inside and attacking those outside - a seal, not a shield.
U_0x007810: A <Personal Trooper> developed by <Mao Industries>. A close-combat unit inheriting the Alt Eisen's concept, usually deployed with the artillery-type Wild Falken. It uses no <EOT>, carrying solid-round short/mid-range weapons, and uses the GII frame rather than the R-1/Huckebein H frame. A high-output <Tesla Drive> permits solo flight under gravity; purging its Jacket Armor shifts it to high-mobility mode. Designed by Dr. Marion Radom. One other unit of the type exists.
U_0x007BB9: A <Personal Trooper> developed by <Mao Industries>. An artillery unit inheriting the Weiss Ritter's concept, its <Tesla Drive> gives it top-class mobility among <Personal Trooper>s. It pairs with the melee-type Wild Wurger; the 'Twin Bird Strike,' a joint attack with it in high-mobility mode, is formidable. Its main weapon, the Oxtongue Rifle, switches between solid rounds and energy shells. Unlike the Wild Wurger it uses the Huckebein-type H frame for rigidity and lighter weight. Developed by Dr. Kirk Hamil. The name is from German 'WILD' and 'WANDERFALKE' (falcon). One other unit of the type exists.
U_0x007FF6: An upgraded remodel of the transformable <Personal Trooper> Wildraubtier. A <Tesla Drive> boosts its mobility and agility, and a new built-in rail cannon plus Blade Sai melee weapons give it far greater firepower.
